record.name: Burst

universal_access.description: Raw Force energy channeled through the ground, available to any Force user

record.narrative: You slam Force energy into the ground beneath you, causing it to erupt outward in a violent shockwave. The power manifests as the earth cracking and heaving, stone and debris exploding outward in a ring of destruction that knocks enemies off balance.
record.flavor_text: "The ground itself obeys the will of the Force." - Ancient Sith Lord

manifestation.description: stomping or striking the ground with force
channeling Force energy downward into the earth

base_effect.description: You cause the earth to burst from beneath your feet, creating a shockwave that affects all creatures around you.

mechanics.notes: All creatures within 5 feet take 1d4 force damage

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe the ground cracking and buckling as Force energy erupts from beneath. Stone fragments and dust explode outward in a circular shockwave. Enemies stumble and fall as the earth heaves beneath their feet. The air fills with debris and the sound of shattering stone.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Burst is a close-range area attack perfect for when you're surrounded. The 5-foot radius hits all adjacent enemies. Only 1d4 damage but requires no resources as a cantrip. Excellent for triggering opportunity attacks as enemies are pushed back.
narrative_hooks: A Jedi uses Burst to escape from a closing circle of enemies
The shockwave reveals a hidden tunnel beneath the floor
A desperate last stand begins with Burst clearing breathing room

image_generation.base_prompt: A dramatic digital painting of a Force user causing the ground to explode outward in a ring of destruction. The earth cracks and heaves, sending stone fragments and dust erupting in a circular shockwave. Enemies are thrown back by the seismic force, debris flying through the air. The Force user stands at the epicenter, surrounded by cracking earth and explosive force.
